title: Firefly Pico through 1.12.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users…
description: Firefly Pico versions through 1.12.1 have an insecure direct object reference (IDOR) vulnerability. Authenticated users can exploit this flaw to overwrite other users' profiles by submitting arbitrary profile IDs. This allows attackers with valid access tokens to update another user's profile via the ProfileController, resulting in reassignment of the profile and loss of the victim's saved settings.
